name: Request Office Attendance Certificate
goal: Employee requests a certificate of office attendance for a specific period.
constraints: Period must be within the last 12 months.

phases.description: User asks for an attendance certificate for a date range.
User provides valid start and end dates within the last 12 months.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms eligibility and generates certificate.
Bot provides a downloadable link or attachment for the certificate.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
